summary.text: Kristine Howard is a Democratic state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 167 since December 1, 2018 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Kristine Howard took office in December 2018, succeeding Republican Duane Milne.

In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Agriculture and Rural Affairs, Children and Youth, Judiciary and State Government committees, and chaired the State Government subcommittee on Government Integrity and Transparency.
